facts.text: Under the GCU Promise program, full-time undergraduate New Jersey residents who receive full Federal Pell and New Jersey Tuition Aid Grants receive coverage for all general fees and up to the full cost of tuition.

sources.title: GCU Promise | Georgian Court University | Lakewood, New Jersey
sources.quote: GCU Promise covers the cost of all general fees and up to the full cost of tuition based on financial need, and students will continue receiving support for their education as long as they remain eligible for Pell and TAG grants.
